title: Parent-to-child Adam moment inheritance at arena clone/split topology events
question: What Adam optimizer state should a newly created clone or split child inherit from its parent Gaussian at a geometric-arena topology event?
hypothesis: Inheriting attenuated parent Adam moments (second moment near gamma_v=1.0, means first moment at gamma_m<=0.5) reduces the post-event loss excursion and the iterations needed to regain pre-event train PSNR relative to the current exact-zero child moments, without degrading equal-wall-clock held-out quality; exact full inheritance of the means first moment overshoots on split children because their positions are offset from the parent.
claim_boundary: Development evidence for the moment-inheritance policy inside the geometric-arena gsplat-default path (rtgs.optim.arena.apply_default_topology_transaction) on the two development-exposed stage frames only. It does not establish geometric-versus-dynamic storage differences (a separately registered follow-up must vary storage_policy at one frozen inheritance setting), gsplat-delegated dynamic-path behavior, MCMC applicability, targeted-versus-global opacity reset value, cross-scene generality, or any production default change.

stages.label: Load matched initialization
stages.purpose: Load one shared frozen 3D initialization and verify its hash, count, and parameters so only the inheritance policy differs between cells.

stages.label: Load train RGB/masks
stages.purpose: Load only the frozen training cameras with calibrated undistortion and lossless masks.

stages.label: Geometric-arena 3DGS optimization
stages.purpose: Run the standard RGB trainer with gaussian_storage_policy=geometric and the gsplat-default strategy under one frozen density schedule and hard budget, applying the cell's clone/split moment-inheritance policy inside every arena topology transaction.

stages.label: Topology event instrumentation
stages.purpose: Extend the existing per-event stats records with pre-event loss, a frozen post-event loss window, child lineage, child/parent gradient norms, and survival horizons, without altering the optimization schedule.

stages.label: Held-out RGB evaluation
stages.purpose: Evaluate every cell on identical held-out cameras at matched iteration count and at the matched wall-clock checkpoint.

comparators.label: Exact-zero child moments (current behavior)
comparators.purpose: The existing _expanded_moment policy; anchors whether any inheritance beats cold-started children.

comparators.label: Exact parent-moment inheritance
comparators.purpose: Clone and both split children copy m and v verbatim (gamma_m=gamma_v=1.0 for every field); tests whether unmodified transfer is sufficient or overshoots.

comparators.label: Attenuated inheritance factorial
comparators.purpose: gamma_m x gamma_v in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} x {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} applied uniformly to all fields; separates first-moment from second-moment inheritance value.

comparators.label: Split-aware per-field profile
comparators.purpose: Field-specific attenuation (means 0.25-0.5, scales 1.0, quaternions 0.5, opacities 0.5, SH/colors 1.0) reflecting that split children move while appearance is preserved; tests whether per-field structure beats one global gamma.

primary_metrics.label: Post-event loss excursion area
primary_metrics.aggregation: area above the pre-event loss level over the frozen post-event window; median over events, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Peak loss within 10 post-event iterations
primary_metrics.aggregation: median over events, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Iterations to regain pre-event train PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: median over events, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Child survival fraction
primary_metrics.aggregation: fraction of clone/split children alive 50, 100, and 500 iterations after birth; reported per horizon, median over events, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR at matched iterations
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR at the matched wall-clock checkpoint
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out SSIM at matched iterations
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Topology event duration
primary_metrics.aggregation: median over profiled events, then median over seeds and scenes

resource_protocol.scope: fresh image-supervised training process from calibrated train-image open through final PLY save; heldout evaluation is timed and reported separately; identical instrumentation runs in every cell so event logging cannot bias one policy
resource_protocol.aggregation: paired median on one idle named GPU; retain every raw repeat and report min/max

blockers: Implement configurable clone/split moment inheritance in rtgs.optim.arena (_expanded_moment must receive clone_rows/split_rows and a per-field gamma profile through apply_default_topology_transaction) behind an opt-in config whose default preserves the current exact-zero behavior, with CPU-first unit tests for shape, ordering, survivor preservation, and child-moment values.

Extend the strategy stats records with per-event loss windows, child lineage, child/parent gradient norms, and survival horizons; freeze the post-event window length and survival horizons after a mechanism-only pilot.
Freeze the shared initialization artifact and its hash, the density schedule, hard budget, total iterations, matched wall-clock checkpoint, and the exact argv command before setting status to ready.
Freeze the CUDA host, GPU identity, and idle policy; this protocol cannot run on the CPU-only reference path.
Assign a frozen owner and obtain a distinct outcome-unseen prospective protocol review.
Register the geometric-versus-dynamic storage comparison as its own follow-up task at one frozen inheritance setting; this task must not combine the two claims.
